A street lamp stopped working. What should I tell 311?
Provide the nearest location or address and explain that the streetlight is out; submit it through your local 311 service.
The garbage truck skipped my block. What information is useful?
Give the service address, collection day, and which waste was not collected; requirements depend on the city.
I already filed a complaint. How do I follow its progress?
Look up the request using its service number on the city 311 portal or ask the city's 311 line.
A large limb is in the pedestrian path. How do I get help?
Report its location to 311 and avoid the area if unsafe; contact emergency services if there is immediate danger.
Do I have to share my phone number when filing a graffiti report?
That depends on the city. Check its 311 site for anonymous options and required fields.
How can I describe a road crater so crews can locate it?
Share the street or intersection, which direction or side, and a nearby landmark.
